title: Wendy and the Dandelion Hat Show
synopsis: Wendy shows Sue Far Meadow, where a single dandelion becomes the silent audience for a show of hats made from fallen leaves. Sue talks about missing her old home while enjoying the round window at her new cottage.
continuity_state: Before: Sue and Grandpa know the orchard and village; Sue has met Amy, Ben, Kim and Todd. Far Meadow is west over Bell Hill. Wendy and Aunt Kay live in cream cottage and Wendy wears straw hat with original blue ribbon. Picnic banner remains indoors at cottage. After: Sue meets Wendy on a supervised trip over Bell Hill via existing halfway bench. They stage a pretend leaf-hat show at the established Sitting Stone for a dandelion, using fallen materials, leaving the flower in place. Sue briefly mentions missing her former square window but also liking the new round one. Grandpa Ed and Sue return over Bell Hill in daylight. Wendy's ribbon and picnic banner remain unchanged.
